ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This online course section, for students in the Peoria cohort, starts August 26 and ends December 9. The Elluminate online conferencing system will be used for synchronous (real-time) class sessions and there will also be 4 face-to-face class sessions held at the University of Illinois, College of Medicine in Peoria in room A200-2. Both the Elluminate online sessions and site-based classes will be held on Wednesdays evenings. The face-to face classes will be held from 6:00 to 9:00 PM. The initial face-to-face meeting will occur on the first day of class, August 26, and the other three site-based meetings are tentatively scheduled for October 7, December 2 and December 9. The email address for the instructor is smithdc@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $386.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $45.00 per Bill Hour.
